sourceText:
Instant Spaghetti
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 3:10pm

Ingredients




2 pounds Ground beef/chicken/turkey
1 jar prepared spaghetti sauce (14 oz.)
1 small Can chopped mushrooms
1 teaspoon Dry oregano
Parmesan cheese, grated
1 pkt Spaghetti (1 lb.)
1 can Tomato sauce (8 oz)
1 cup Water
1 teaspoon Dry thyme
1 Bay leaf
2 Garlic cloves, minced

Preparation

1 Cook spaghetti noodles in boiling water with a dash of salt and a few drops of oil for about 20 minutes or until ready. In a large frying pan cook meat until brown. Add tomato sauce, spaghetti sauce, garlic, thyme, oregano, bay leaf and drained mushrooms. Mix together well and cook over medium heat for 45 minutes. Pour sauce over spaghetti and serve with Parmesan cheese if desired.
